notes.title: Ninja Avenger Update is here !
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28070209/e3b933be9eff9d3a437f31291aa6cae57d5fe1f8.png[/img]

We are happy to have released the new version of Ninja Avenger Dragon Blade with a new gameplay, open world, beautiful environments, new enemies, quest system, inventory system, change weapons, buy rings and artifacts or potions from the merchants, evolved set of skills, great looking special effects, possibility to interact with NPC and discover more of the puzzle pieces of the story. This time you can rotate your camera with your mouse at full 360 degrees, attack with left click and use special skill with right click. The game is now open world which means after doing the quests you can continue to explore the maps and even farm by killing wolves for increasing your hero's stats.
We have included the Manga inside the game as well.

If you want to update to this version, simply uninstall the old game and install it again and you will have the current new version.

We plan on adding even more neat stuff to the game depending on it's success...Hope you like it

Thank you
